title: Peace in 24 hours, cheaper fuel: Trump’s promises against his record
lead: He pledged to end russia’s war within a day and to halve energy bills. Twenty-one months on, the US is at war with Iran, petrol has gone from $3 to $4.27, tariffs of up to 500% on russia were waived two days before they took effect, and voters are promised $5,000 each if Republicans win.
imageAlt: Illustration: Donald Trump’s face split in two. On the left, in smoke, the word WORDS, burning oil rigs and thick smoke below them; on the right a face that looks cast in metal, the word DEALS, containers marked TARIFFS and portraits labelled China, EU, India and Saudi Arabia. Below, fighter jets, container ships and soldiers
